title: Ash on the key
line1: The key survived the fire.
line2: Marrow kept your sibling debt and your name.
line3: The young Mechanic opens the shop with shaking hands.

title: The first invoice
line1: The engine turns over at last.
line2: A race receipt buys a part.
line3: Every payment leaves another question in the ledger.

title: Loose ground
line1: Scree hides yesterday under fresh stone.
line2: The Mechanic patches your tires before dawn.
line3: A bare frame waits behind his parts counter.

title: A sealed box
line1: Relay offers work without a signature.
line2: Deliveries pay better when nobody asks what is inside.
line3: You can refuse and still keep racing.

title: A local debt
line1: Rook once owed this same garage.
line2: He calls the debt a lesson.
line3: His hands shake when Marrow is mentioned.

title: Numbers under soot
line1: A scorched receipt survives behind a tool rack.
line2: Part of your payment never reached the debt.
line3: Marrow calls the missing money a handling charge.

title: Rook at the gate
line1: Rook blocks the road out of the Yards.
line2: Win this race and he will promote your name.
line3: Cash or a car or a fitted part: you choose.

title: Foundry row
line1: Rook has put his name beside yours.
line2: Ox races to keep his foundry crew employed.
line3: The Mechanic follows with a truck full of parts.

title: Easy money
line1: A lender offers an advance with a fixed fee.
line2: The ledger makes the price plain.
line3: The safer climb needs no signature.

title: Weight of a promise
line1: Ox gives no ground on a straight.
line2: His heavy car needs room to turn.
line3: The crew watches every brake light.

title: A second name
line1: Your sibling used a false name at Ridge Wire.
line2: Mica recognizes the handwriting on the entry form.
line3: She pockets the page before you can ask why.

title: The crew account
line1: Crew wages appear as penalties in the debt book.
line2: Your diverted payments bought Marrow private fleet.
line3: Ox brings the receipts that can prove it.

title: Borrowed steel
line1: Relay finds a chassis with an honest serial plate.
line2: Trading the old car leaves its parts behind.
line3: Choose what the next field demands.

title: Ox holds the line
line1: Ox lays duplicate receipts on your bonnet.
line2: Beat him and his crew will stand behind you.
line3: The diverted money goes back on your account.

title: White horizon
line1: Ox has forced the collector to correct the books.
line2: Future payments now reach the debt in full.
line3: Vex knows where the missing driver went.

title: A dry footprint
line1: A shelter holds a glove from your garage.
line2: The stitching is fresh.
line3: Your sibling survived the fire.

title: Switch in the crate
line1: Someone switched the ammunition in a sealed crate.
line2: The Mechanic catches it before you leave the shop.
line3: He keeps the empty dispatcher for his bare frame.

title: Vex runs ahead
line1: Vex saw a car leave after the last official race.
line2: Its driver carried a copy of Marrow books.
line3: He will tell you where for a clean contest.

title: The missing lap
line1: An official result omits an entire lap.
line2: The payment still lists a full race.
line3: The same account number appears again.

title: Relay at dusk
line1: Relay admits moving sealed ledgers for the league.
line2: One delivery went north instead of to Marrow.
line3: Mica arranged the change.

title: Vex opens the throttle
line1: Vex has kept the northbound address safe.
line2: Win and he will carry your name to the next division.
line3: His promotion comes as cash or a car or a part.

title: The mountain road
line1: Cold air reaches the engine before dawn.
line2: Mica waits above the last town.
line3: The Mechanic has hidden your sibling in his workshop.

title: The books
line1: The duplicate debts paid for Marrow private fleet.
line2: A wreck became a new fee on the next page.
line3: Your garage burned when the copies disappeared.

title: A voice on the line
line1: Your sibling calls from the safe workshop.
line2: The Mechanic was afraid to tell you until now.
line3: He stayed because someone had to keep a door open.

title: Water over ink
line1: Mica divides the evidence among the crews.
line2: One lost race can no longer erase it.
line3: The mountain still demands an exact line.

title: A remembered wreck
line1: A rival carries a grudge into the next grid.
line2: The passing gets sharper.
line3: The car obeys the same rules as before.

title: No private deal
line1: Marrow offers to clear only your family debt.
line2: The Mechanic turns down a price for your location.
line3: Mica sends the private deal back unsigned.

title: Mica tests the line
line1: Mica divides the evidence among the crews.
line2: Beat her and she will promote the driver carrying it.
line3: No single wreck can burn every copy now.

title: Inside the gates
line1: Marrow opens his own speedway to the circuit.
line2: The crews arrive with copies of the ledger.
line3: The cameras now belong to everyone.

title: The house cars
line1: The league drivers bring the cars they could afford.
line2: Victories paid for their parts.
line3: Wrecks cost them the same way they cost you.

title: A public account
line1: Relay reads the duplicate entries over the pit radio.
line2: Ox confirms where your payments went.
line3: Even a cleared balance cannot satisfy Marrow.

title: The last shipment
line1: The Mechanic fits the mine dispatcher in his rig.
line2: A plain engine. A rough seat. A real chance.
line3: He does not ask you to trust another secret.

title: Vex returns
line1: Vex gives every crew an unedited race recording.
line2: Marrow has run out of numbers to hide behind.
line3: He starts talking about ownership instead.

title: Before the Crown
line1: Marrow demands your car as collateral after this race.
line2: The Mechanic rolls his bare rig out of the shop.
line3: One more result before the debt becomes a death fight.

title: Marrow on his road
line1: Marrow seizes your car under a fabricated lien.
line2: The Mechanic gives you his rig and mine dispatcher.
line3: No lap victory. Last car running ends his reign.
